title: Marina Electricity Outage Duration
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marina:power pedestal_id=* outage_start_epoch=* outage_end_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((outage_end_epoch-outage_start_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by pedestal_id
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures shore-power outage duration by power pedestal for marina electricity reliability.
value: Lag tracking shows which power pedestal create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside marina electricity reliability.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `shore-power outage duration` on `marina:power` events and aggregate them by `pedestal_id`.
visualization: Table of power pedestal with average and worst shore-power outage duration.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long things take for each power pedestal so you can see where marina electricity reliability slows down.
